episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the impact of AI on luxury real estate, emphasizing the shift towards lifestyle optimization among high-end buyers. She highlights the importance of personal branding and digital presence in the AI era, offering strategies for agents to stand out in competitive markets. The conversation also covers practical tips for winning multiple offer situations and the value of building strong relationships in the industry.
